==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
{{DIcon|Talk}} (Adventure Log Courier Truck)
;A Lollo Logistics vehicle with a strange paint job... Now where have I seen it before?
:{{DIcon}} Examine the vehicle.
::;The loudspeaker on the vehicle is playing an advertisement with funny music.
::'''[[Lollo Logistics Truck]]:''' "Take out your Terminal—your trusty wish-granter! Lollo Logistics and the Pioneer Association are here to back your favorite campain: Beyound the Waves, loaded up with perks and goodies!"
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Upload your Adventur Logs to this courier truck, and you'll recieve an 'Adventure Package' for the corresponding location filled with surprises!"
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Lollo express shipping service gets another upgrade! Tiered discounts are now bigger, better, and stronger than ever across the whole campain!" 
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "A friendly reminder: While lovely views and rewards are up for grabs, remember that safety always comes first! Be safe and happy adventuring!"
{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
----
; (Watch the ads)
: ''The loudspeaker on the vehicle is playing an advertisement with funny music.''
: '''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Take out your Terminal—your trusty wish-granter! It's time to dive into some juicy perks again with Lollo Logistics’ 10-billion-worth subsidies. Available to all Pioneers and couriers!"
: '''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "From the victory in the Norfall Barrens to the return of Mt. Firmament, and the successful Moon-Chasing Festival, Jinzhou's unique brilliance is shining bright across Solaris, one remarkable event after another!"
: '''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "As a way to encourage our Pioneers and couriers to further share their Jinzhou explorations, Lollo Logistics has partnered with the Pioneer Association to proudly present the campaign: Beyond the Waves!"
: '''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Be it a journey to mountains, valleys, the bustling city, or quiet towns, just upload your Adventure Logs in Jinzhou to this courier truck, and you'll receive an ‘Adventure Package' for the corresponding location filled with surprises!"
: '''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "But that's not all. Enjoy same-day delivery across the Jinzhou area with upgraded Lollo express shipping services to better tailor to all your traveling needs during the campaign! Tiered discounts included!"
: '''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "A friendly reminder: While lovely views and rewards are up for grabs, remember that safety always comes first! In the case of an emergency, please call the nearby Midnight Rangers for assistance!"
----
:(Knock on Window)
:After giving it a few tabs, the courier truck stops its broadcast, and a line of words appears on the screen.
:'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' Greetings! How may I be of assitance?
:{{DIcon}} Sorry, I couldn't resist.
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' ——(generating response).
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' I see. Please enjoy your tapping! Your feedback has been recorded. We will consider adding a rhythm-based interactive entertainment module to our logistics vehicles in the future.

:'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' Beep. Thank you for choosing Lollo Logistics—We Promise, We Deliver! For further assistance, press 1. To access the Beyond the Waves campaign, press 2. If you wish to speak to a representative, please contact business manager [[Maji]].
----
;[[Beyond_the_Waves/2024-11-21]]
:{{DIcon}} License and registration, please.
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' I apologize, but this is an automated, driverless courtesy vehicle recently developed by Lollo Logistics. To ensure maximum safety and transportation efficiency, this vehicle does not have a human operator.
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' Smart Suggestion: If you wish to inquire about the entry records of non-local vehicles in Jinzhou, you may find relevant information within the City Hall's event log.

:{{DIcon}} How much to the [[Black Shores]]?
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' I apologize. This vehicle is currently unable to handle cross-sea transportation nor provide passenger services.
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' Smart Suggestion: If you wish to travel to the Black Shores, please contact a Black Shores representative. Data indicates that visits are currently by invitation only.
----
;[[Beyond the Waves]]
:{{DIcon}} How much do you charge for advertisements?
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' This is an automated, driverless cortesy vehicle recently developed by Lollo Logistics. If you have queries related to promotional partnership opportunities, you're welcome to visit our Lollo Logistics Center for further details.
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' Smart Suggestion: Lollo Logistics Centers can be found across various areas and locations. Please be sure to refer to our one and only Lollo Logistics logo!

:{{DIcon}} When can I hop on for a ride, boss?
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "I apologize. This vehicle currently supports delivery and advertisement function only, and is unable to provide passenger services."
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Smart Suggestion: If you are in need of a passenger vehicle, we recommend trying out Echo vehicles, which may bring you a fresh and unique riding experience!"
----
;[[Beyond the Waves/2025-05-29]]
:{{DIcon}} When can I hop on for a ride, boss? 
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "I apologize, but this is an automated, driverless courtesy vehicle recently developed by Lollo Logistics for transportation and advertising purposes only. No flying function available..."
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Smart Suggestion: If you are in need of a flying vehicle, we recommend trying out Wingrays, which may bring you a fresh and unique flying experience in Ragunna!"

:{{DIcon}} Seriously, how many rounds of this campaign do you plan on running?
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "This campaign is brought to you by Lollo Logistics and the Pioneer Association, aiming to bring precious memories and exciting surprises to your adventurous journey."
:'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' Smart Suggestion: Lollo Logistics is here to bring you an entirely new and exciting experience! Stay tuned!" {{sic}}
----
;[[Beyond the Waves/2025-09-25]]
:{{DIcon}} Where's Maji?
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "――(generating response)."
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Transferring your call to Manager Maji. Please hold... While you wait, enjoy this brief commercial break: Lollo Logistics shipping service is now fully upgraded! Place your order today and enjoy exclusive discounts!"
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Beep. Sorry, the number you've dialed is currently busy. Please try again later."

:{{DIcon}} Why does this thing not have wings yet?
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "I apologize, but this is an automated, driverless courtesy vehicle recently developed by Lollo Logistics for transportation and advertising purposes only. No flying function available..."
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Smart Suggestion: If you are in need of a flying vehicle, we recommend trying out Wingrays, which may bring you a fresh and unique flying experience in Ragunna!"
----
;[[Beyond the Waves:Lahai-Roi/2026-01-01]]
:{{DIcon}} Where's Maji? Where's he gone again?
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "——(generating response)."
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Transferring your call to Manager Maji. Please hold... While you wait, enjoy this brief commercial break: Lollo Logistics shipping service is now fully upgraded! Place your order today and enjoy exclusive discounts!"
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Beep. Sorry, the number you've dialed is currently busy. Please try again later."

:{{DIcon}} So, can you fly now?
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Thank you for your continued feedback. Your concerns are our priorities! The proposal to add flight capability to the promotional vehicle is subject to a formal review. Headquarters is currently evaluating the associated costs, benefits, and technicle feasibility..."
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "Smart Suggestion: If you are in need of a flying vehicle in Lahai-Roi, we recommend trying out Jetray, which may bring you a fresh and unique flying experience in Lahai-Roi!"

:{{DIcon}} Sorry, I couldn't resist.
::'''Lollo Logistics Truck:''' "I see. Please enjoy your tapping! A rhythm-based interactive entertainment module for this vehicleis currently under development. It has passed the first round of review, and it is estimated to take... another several rounds of review. Please stay tuned."
{{Dialogue End}}
